nom: Garnier SkinActive Charcoal Blackhead Eliminating Scrub

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one in a humid climate, report noticeably less excess oil and softer skin after use, with one saying it's the only face soap she's stuck with over an 'oily life.'
segments.sensitive: The one reviewer with sensitive skin, a teenager described by her mother, reports no redness or irritation, unlike some salicylic acid products, while quickly reducing blackheads around her nose.

concerns.dehydration: Reports are mixed: one reviewer says it dried her skin out and left it feeling merely soft rather than exfoliated, while others, including one with oily skin, say it does not dry out or irritate their skin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports no redness at all; another reviewer references other users' complaints of redness as likely an allergy or sensitivity reaction, without reporting it herself.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers, including one with sensitive skin, report no irritation from the scrub.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports large, persistent dark discoloration appeared around her mouth and chin after a few days of nightly use and had not fully faded weeks later.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports her blackhead-prone nose cleared quickly after a single use; another, however, says her face broke out more than the product she was using before.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer who addresses oil control reports noticeably less excess oil the morning after use, in a humid climate.

aspects.libelle: Microbeads can get in eyes and cause lasting pain
Gentle, smooth texture, less rough than St. Ives
Cheaper in stores than on Amazon
Increasingly hard to find in stores

extraits.texte: I was having high expectations when I bought this scrub without even knowing all the mess that was gonna bring to my face. I started it using it every night and after a couple of days of trying it I started getting this huge black patches around my mouth and chin. This is the worst thing that has ever happened to my skin. So disappointed. First picture is how my skin got after just a few days of using this scrub, and the second one is from today, I still can't get all the discoloration off all together.

extraits.titre: Ok for the price if it's on sale
extraits.texte: Seems to have made my face breakout more than one I was using before this, hoping my face just need to get used to it

extraits.titre: It works, just not right for me.
extraits.texte: I gave it time but I wasn’t too fond of this face wash, yes it worked but it made my skin feel dry and it left a soft feeling after using, I didn’t feel like it exfoliated my skin the way I’d like it too.

We've researched how beneficial charcoal can be for a beauty routine, so we looked forward to trying this Garnier SkinActive Charcoal Blackhead Acne Treatment Scrub. My aspiring actress/model daughter uses a charcoal toothpaste for whitening at the recommendation of other professionals in her field, and with great results. I wasn't sure what to expect from this face scrub; it is a clear, thin gel and sparsely contains charcoal "micro-beads" that makes the cleanser a little gritty. It has a nice clean scent, nothing overpowering. It states: "After One Use: Unclogs pores and smooths skin" -- my daughter only used this on/around her nose and really did see instant mattifying results from her first use (as you can kind of see in the pictures, it was hard to capture!) She sometimes gets the oily/spotty "Strawberry Nose" blackheads, and this worked impressively quick to combat that. She has pretty sensitive skin, and this did not cause any redness or irritation, which sometimes happens with other products containing Salicylic Acid. Directions are simple: "Apply the face wash and massage gently, avoiding contact with eyes. Rinse face thoroughly." -- a little bit was all that was necessary for her nose, so this product should last awhile. She rubbed it in, and let it sit on her skin for a few minutes, before washing off with warm water, and following up with her usual cleanser/Mia routine. I'm not sure if she'll use this daily, or only as-needed to get the results. The price is fanta

I'm a sucker for new skin care especially when I complete a bottle but lately I've been in search of a face mask.. This was pretty perfect! I have oily skin on top of Florida humidity which is a recipe for disaster at any age (I'm almost 29) and so far, day one after a mask and I woke up to noticeable softness with no excess oils! It's the first time in, well, probably since I was a child! this and the neutrageona hydroboost are my new regimes and will be for quite some time! Also, for the people complaining of redness-that's why they tell you to skin test. That is an allergy/you have ultra sensitive skin so stop using it?

extraits.titre: A charcoal facial scrub that does not disappoint!!!
extraits.texte: This is the only charcoal facial scrub I have found that does not dry out or irritate my skin. My local WalMart & Target stores stopped selling it a few years ago so I was happy to find it at Amazon now.

I’ve been using this product and buying it from a local grocery store for longer than I can remember. When they stopped carrying it I, like a dummy, tried several other products. When told they weren’t going to restock it after a massive remodel, I finally snapped and thought to look for it on Amazon. Why didn’t I think of it before! Now, I buy three bottles at a time. And will buy more if I ever find out it might get discontinued. Have tried hundreds of face soaps over my oily life. This is the one I stick with!
